terms_summary: Every published model is dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0. Commercial use, modification and redistribution are allowed without attribution, account or fees. Grab3D waives only its own rights; trademark/patent and depicted-subject rights are not waived. Subjects are described as generic, with no brands, logos or real people.
origin_policy: Many packages are AI-assisted: a Meshy image-to-3D draft is cleaned up, scaled, textured and checked in Blender. Rigged packages add Meshy Auto-Rig skeletons and clips. Each package LICENSE.txt and manifest.json disclose the method; the intake adapter preserves both and tags candidates ai-assisted.

rejected_packages.teen-character-rigged: Technically clean, but anime/stylized face and hair; rejected for the realistic-human category.

rejected_alternatives.mb-lab: AGPL-3.0 data and generated characters are treated as AGPL derivatives; incompatible with the no-strings policy.
rejected_alternatives.avatar-studio: Realistic MPFB-derived GLBs exist, but the repository LICENSE is MIT for code and the CC0 claim for models is README-level; prefer packages with explicit per-package CC0 dedications.
